PLANNING YOUR CLEAN

What shapes your quote?

Your space

The size of your home and number of bathrooms help us estimate the work involved.

How much attention it needs

A first visit or built-up dirt may need more time than routine upkeep.

Your cleaning routine

Tell us whether you need a one-time visit or regular help, and when your home was last cleaned.

The extras on your list

Oven interiors, laundry, and other extra tasks need time too. Mention them when requesting a quote.

The homeowner provides cleaning supplies and equipment. We’ll discuss the tasks and timing with you before arranging a visit.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few common questions.

Who provides cleaning supplies and equipment?

Please provide the cleaning supplies and equipment needed for your home. We can discuss what to have ready before your visit.

Can I book a recurring cleaning?

Yes. Daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and occasional cleaning are available. Get in touch to discuss a schedule.

Are the condo prices fixed?

Yes—regular cleaning is $90 for a one-bedroom condo and $120 for a two-bedroom condo. Extra tasks and deep cleaning are quoted separately. We’ll confirm the scope and any applicable taxes before you book.

Do you clean houses as well?

Yes. Share a few details about your house and the cleaning you need so we can provide a personal quote.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Toronto. Include your neighbourhood when you contact us so we can confirm availability at your address.
